original.target_description: Overall Mantel–Haenszel odds ratio of publication of statistically significant versus nonsignificant dissertation outcomes; education broadly, not restricted to special education.

n.exclusions: Included matched studies meeting intervention/outcome/testing criteria; no additional exclusions for the overall odds ratio identified.

n.quote: Within the 79 studies, we found 1,599 different treatment outcomes.

replication.target_description: Overall odds ratio that significant and nonsignificant findings reported in special education dissertations would also be reported in corresponding journal publications

n.sample_role: Treatment/intervention outcomes (analytic observations), drawn from 40 dissertation–publication pairs; not individual participants.
n.exclusions: Final pool follows exclusion of 167 dissertations lacking a corresponding publication and three during coding (one publication mismatch, one single-case design, one not an intervention). Only intervention-effect hypothesis tests extracted; pretest-equivalence, regression-assumption and correlational tests excluded. Overall model explicitly covers all 707 treatment outcomes.
n.location: p. 7, Research Question 1 and Table 2; pp. 4–5, screening and extraction
n.quote: odds ratio for the 707 treatment outcomes was 1.48 (with a ... 95% confidence interval ranging from 1.10 to 2.00).
